title: Anatomy of a Candlestick
subtitle: Every candle encodes four prices for one time period — open, high, low, and close.
subject: candlestick

parts.label: Upper wick
parts.description: The thin line above the body. Its top marks the highest price traded during the period.

parts.label: High
parts.description: The peak of the upper wick — the most buyers were willing to pay before sellers pushed back.

parts.label: Close
parts.description: Where price settled at the end of the period. On a green candle it sits at the top of the body.

parts.label: Open
parts.description: Where price started. Below the close here, so the body is filled green to show net buying.

parts.label: Real body
parts.description: The thick rectangle between open and close. Its height shows how decisively price moved.

parts.label: Lower wick
parts.description: The line below the body; its bottom marks the lowest price traded.
